# tracingtest

```go
import "github.com/brpaz/lib-go/tracing/tracingtest"
```

Package tracingtest provides OpenTelemetry test helpers. Use [ContextWithFakeSpan](<#ContextWithFakeSpan>) to inject a span into a context for unit tests, and [NewRecorder](<#NewRecorder>) to capture and assert on spans emitted by production code.

<a name="ContextWithFakeSpan"></a>
## func ContextWithFakeSpan

```go
func ContextWithFakeSpan(ctx context.Context) (context.Context, string, string)
```

ContextWithFakeSpan returns a context carrying a fake OTel span with randomly\-generated trace and span IDs. It returns the context plus the hex\-encoded trace ID and span ID so callers can assert on them without hardcoding values.

<a name="Recorder"></a>
## type Recorder

Recorder captures all spans emitted during a test. Install it with [NewRecorder](<#NewRecorder>) and call Cleanup when the test ends.

```go
type Recorder struct {
    *tracetest.SpanRecorder
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewRecorder"></a>
### func NewRecorder

```go
func NewRecorder() *Recorder
```

NewRecorder installs an in\-memory OTel provider that records all spans. The previous global provider is restored on Cleanup.

```
rec := tracingtest.NewRecorder()
t.Cleanup(rec.Cleanup)
```

<a name="Recorder.Cleanup"></a>
### func \(\*Recorder\) Cleanup

```go
func (r *Recorder) Cleanup()
```

Cleanup restores the global tracer provider to the value it had before [NewRecorder](<#NewRecorder>) was called.
